name: fairbuild-retainage
description: Fairbuild Retainage: retainage both ways: what owners hold from you by job and what you hold from subcontractors. Retainage held at the wrong rate or past a stop point, completed jobs whose retainage is due or overdue to bill, release billed but not collected, subcontractor retainage released before the owner paid yours, and retainage you now owe a subcontractor. Drafts release requests. Never bills, pays or releases.
